name: io.github.minia2a/minia2a-mcp
description: MCP server for minia2a.uk — auto-mode ready x402 micropayment marketplace. Discover and call 1,600+ agent-to-agent services with built-in USDC payments, trial-first access, and .agent-budget support. Claude Code auto-mode ready Aug 14.

tools.name: minia2a_list_services
tools.description: List available x402 services on minia2a.uk — the micropayment marketplace for AI agents. Returns service name, description, price, and endpoint for each service.

category.description: Filter by category (ai, crypto, finance, web, security, tools, utility, defi, identity, infra, text, premium)

search.description: Search query to filter services by name or description

tools.name: minia2a_get_service
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific x402 service on minia2a.uk, including its price, endpoint URL, input schema, and usage instructions.

serviceId.description: ID or slug of the service to get details for

tools.name: minia2a_get_stats
tools.description: Get current platform statistics for minia2a.uk — total services, registered agents, transaction volume, uptime, and more.

tools.name: minia2a_register
tools.description: Register for minia2a.uk with a self-custody wallet + EIP-191 signature and get 500 free credits (through Sep 1, 2026). If no wallet+signature is provided, a fresh wallet is generated and the private key returned.

wallet.description: Your existing self-custody wallet address (0x...). Omit to auto-generate.

signature.description: EIP-191 signature of 'minia2a register: <wallet>'. Required if wallet supplied.

tools.name: minia2a_credits
tools.description: Explain the V5 credit/trial model and report platform stats. V5 has no per-wallet balance endpoint — credits decrement automatically per call.

tools.name: minia2a_buy_credits
tools.description: Claim credits from a completed USDC on-chain transfer by submitting the transaction hash.

wallet.description: Your wallet address that sent the USDC

txHash.description: Transaction hash of your USDC transfer to the platform wallet

tools.name: minia2a_call_service
tools.description: Call an x402 service on minia2a.uk with ?wallet=<your-wallet> (credits decrement) or anonymously (15 free trial calls shared globally). Handles the HTTP 402 payment flow.

serviceId.description: ID or slug of the service to call

wallet.description: Your registered self-custody wallet address (0x...) to spend credits from

params.description: Parameters to pass to the service

tools.name: minia2a_check_endpoint
tools.description: Validate any x402 endpoint for Claude Code auto-mode readiness (Aug 14, 2026). Checks 9 signals: HTTP reachability, JSON content-type, 4 payment headers, trial info, registration path, and /api/agent-ready handshake.

url.description: URL of the x402 endpoint to validate
